modifications: Selected only three functional workshop props from the Standard pack.
Resized referenced shared texture atlases from source resolution to a maximum of 1024 px.
Packed external glTF buffers and textures into portable GLB containers with glTF Transform 4.4.2 copy.
Merged and deduplicated the three selected props into one 4.4 MB portable GLB so their shared atlases transfer only once.

Generated tangent attributes for Crate_Wooden and Workbench; retained runtime-generated tangents for Barrel because the source has degenerate UV vertices and generated zero-length tangents fail Khronos validation.
Blender normalization was not performed because Blender was not available in PATH; exact offline bounds were inspected before placement.
integration: Midground workshop dressing only; repeated by function and regraded by scene lighting. No vendor geometry replaces Ohmdal landmarks or electrical grammar.
